model_name: APC synthetic stack and temporal-event baselines v1

development_history: The first fixed-banner development checkpoint reconstructed only 75% of complete events on validation because actor-seat recognition confused seat 3 with seat 2.
A later development checkpoint passed validation but reconstructed only 75% of complete events on its untouched test because an all-in was classified as a raise with the wrong amount.
The architecture was then changed before this independent audit: action columns are fixed, actor digits are segmented and all-in amount is derived from the pre-action stack observation.

limitations: All evidence in this card comes from deterministic synthetic renderers and cannot promote APC for arbitrary visible tables.
Stack OCR assumes renderer-v2 fixed-width integer digits; arbitrary fonts, decimal stacks, occlusion and all-in labels are unsupported.
Event recognition assumes two adjacent frames and a fixed visible event banner; animations, banner-free clients and multiple actions between frames are unsupported.
Confidence is uncalibrated, player identities are not recognized and the recommendation gate remains closed.
